title: Spud Speedster
description: A BBBoatHud module for showing your speed in spud form! (For ice boat racing)
body:
A simple BBBoatHud module displaying your speed in a spud!

How to use:
- Install BBBoatHud
- Install and enable this resource pack
- Enter a world or server and type `/bb_boat_hud` and click the link
- Browse the avalible modules for the spud module
- Click the button to add it, you can then position it where ever you like on the screen
